title: Operator kickoff, compliance acceptance, and customer handoff playbook
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Overview:

This playbook defines the coordinated steps for a successful operator kickoff, compliance acceptance testing (CAT), and handoff to the customer operations team for Redwood Private deployments (VPC and on-prem). It consolidates pre-flight checks, packaging attestations, day-2 responsibilities, upgrade/rollback acceptance criteria, and a minimal evidence catalog required for compliance review.

Scope:
- Applies to all Private deployments delivered by Redwood Inference: VPC-hosted control plane, delegated/federated control plane, and fully on-prem air-gapped installations.
- Targets deployments where a formal customer handoff and compliance attestation is required (regulated industries: finance, healthcare, government).

Owner and stakeholders:
- Document owner: Customer Success (Aisha Patel)
- Primary stakeholders: Field Operators, Platform Engineering, Security & Compliance, Customer NOC
- Approvers: Head of Customer Success, Compliance

Acceptance gates and timeline:
1. Preflight complete: network, hardware, KMS, and model artifact integrity checks passed.
2. Compliance Acceptance Test (CAT): telemetry contract and evidence bundle validated.
3. Operator kickoff: on-site/remote knowledge transfer & runbook validation.
4. Formal handoff: customer signs acceptance certificate; Redwood hands over operator playbooks and support SLAs.

Preflight checklist (condensed):
| Area | Minimum requirement | Owner |
|------|---------------------|-------|
| Hardware | Node count >= requested capacity; accelerator firmware signed and latest LTS | Customer/Field Ops |
| Network | BGP/peers configured; egress policy and MTU validated; < 50ms intra-region RTT | Customer Network |
| KMS/HSM | Key provisioning, attestation, and rotation schedule defined | Security Team |
| Model Artifacts | Signed manifests; SHA256 checksums for each artifact | Platform Engineering |
| Telemetry | Agent installed; metrics ingress verified; retention policy agreed (90d default) | Platform & Customer NOC |

Detailed operator kickoff procedure:
1. Schedule a 4-hour kickoff session with participants listed in the "Owner and stakeholders" section.
2. Walk through operator runbooks: startup, graceful degradation, and model swap.
3. Run smoke workload (see "Smoke test" below) and validate SLOs.
4. Confirm alerting and SLO dashboards are accessible to customer observers.
5. Sign the Operator Readiness Sheet (template in "related_pages").

Smoke test (example commands):
- Verify model endpoint responds:
  - curl -X POST https://<tenant-proxy>/v1/generate -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
- Validate latency and throughput baseline (sample PromQL):
  - avg_over_time(redwood_inference_request_latency_seconds{job="serving",tenant="customerX"}[5m]) < 0.5

CAT (Compliance Acceptance Test) checklist:
- Telemetry contract verification:
  - Metrics: per-tenant token_count, request_latency_histogram, kv_cache_hit_ratio
  - Logs: redwood.request.{request_id} with redacted PII fields
  - Evidence: end-to-end signed telemetry manifest and sample retention export
- Evidence bundle (minimum):
  - Signed node inventory (CSV)
  - Firmware/BIOS attestation report
  - KMS provisioning snapshot
  - Model artifact manifest and checksums
  - Telemetry sample export (7 days) with hash
  - Operator Readiness Sheet (signed)

Upgrade and rollback acceptance criteria:
- Upgrade acceptance:
  - Canary run (10% traffic) for 30 minutes with zero fatal errors and less than 5% latency regression vs baseline.
  - KV cache warming period observed; no more than 2% request failures during warmup window.
- Rollback triggers:
  - Any fatal error impacting >1% of requests for 5 continuous minutes.
  - SLO breach: 99th percentile latency increase > 2x baseline for >10 minutes.
- Rollback procedure (condensed):
  1. Trigger orchestration: scale down new model pods to 0, increase previous version to desired capacity.
  2. Re-attach model artifact snapshot and validate checksums.
  3. Verify KV cache convergence and run smoke tests.
  4. Preserve forensic logs; assemble rollback evidence bundle.

Operator responsibilities (first 30 days):
- Nightly health checks (automated): disk pressure, GPU temperature, process restarts
- Weekly artifact refresh validation and signature verification
- Monthly compliance snapshot export and evidence handover
- On-call escalation: Tier 1 operator -> Platform Oncall -> Security (for integrity incidents)

Runbook snippets (examples):
- Force graceful model rollback via CLI:
  - redwoodctl rollout rollback --tenant customerX --model-id model:v2 --reason "latency-regression"
- Collect forensic evidence for upgrade failure:
  - redwoodctl collect evidence --tenant customerX --since "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" --out /tmp/evidence.tar.gz

Acceptance certificate template (to be signed by customer):
- Customer: <customer-name>
- Deployment id: <deployment-id>
- Deployment type: VPC | On-prem
- Preflight completed: yes/no
- CAT completed: yes/no
- Operator kickoff: date/time
- Signed by: <customer-ops> / <redwood-rep>

Related artifacts and attachments:
- Example telemetry manifest (JSON) — attach signed export
- Operator Readiness Sheet (spreadsheet)
- Sample evidence bundle checklist (archive)

Escalation and post-handoff support model:
- 30-day hypercare window: Redwood provides 24/7 operator-to-operator escalation for critical incidents.
- After hypercare: standard enterprise SLA applies; quarterly QBRs and runbook reviews.

Change log:

Appendix A — Telemetry contract (minimal required metrics):
- redwood_inference_requests_total (labels: tenant, route, model_version)
- redwood_inference_request_latency_seconds_bucket (labels: tenant, route, model_version)
- redwood_kv_cache_hits_total and redwood_kv_cache_misses_total (labels: tenant, model_version)

Appendix B — Evidence bundle manifest example (one-line JSON):
{"deployment_id":"dep-12345","collected_at":"2026-10-05T14:00:00Z","items":["node-inventory.csv","firmware-report.pdf","telemetry-sample.ndjson"]}
